guide.alien_fauna.title: Field Guide
guide.alien_fauna.cannonbolt.description: A gentle armoured alien that rolls up into a ball.
guide.alien_fauna.cannonbolt.habitat: Savanna and badlands, alone or in small groups. Now and then a baby is among them. A baby takes twenty minutes to grow up.
guide.alien_fauna.cannonbolt.behaviour: Wild ones wander slowly and now and then curl up and roll somewhere for fun, then stand dizzy for a moment. If hurt, one leans forward, curls up and rolls at whatever hurt it, then stands dizzy and takes extra damage. A ball cannot be hurt at all: a punch only sends it rolling and projectiles bounce off. A baby never fights.
guide.alien_fauna.cannonbolt.befriending: A melon slice calms an angry Cannonbolt, so no fight has to be finished. A few slices tame it. A tame one follows its owner, sits or stands with an empty-hand click, heals from melon slices and rolls at whatever attacks its owner. Two tame ones at full health, each fed a melon slice, breed, and their baby belongs to the same owner. Melon slices also make a tame baby grow up faster.
guide.alien_fauna.cannonbolt.drops: Nothing. A Cannonbolt never drops anything, and nothing in this mod needs one to be killed. The Field Guide itself is a book, a yellow dye and a melon slice.
item.alien_fauna.field_guide.tooltip: Use it on a creature to open its page.
guide.alien_fauna.intro: Strange creatures from beyond the stars have settled in the Overworld. This book is meant to help identify and chronicle them. Choose a creature on the right, or use the book on one to open its page.
